name: IOV Pressure system
descriptions: Composed of a Kerosene tank and one air tank besides many pipes and an airpump.
Shows a pressure gauge
Sturdy machinery, the apparatus is made out of dense metal,

name: Kerosene container
descriptions: A container for kerosene. It is a large rectangular can, dull orange color.
It is full of kerosene. Will fill half of the IOV kerosene tank.
The liquid inside is dark and oily. It has a strong odor.

name: IOV Mantle
descriptions: A mantle for the IOV lamp.
A soft silk mesh, white in color.
Some say it is radioactive. It has no specific odor to it.

name: IOV Spirit Pan
descriptions: A pan for spirit. It's circular shape holds a bit of spirit.
With a nice handle to hold it by.
A brass color, small enough to handle with one hand.

name: Denatured alcohol barrel
descriptions: A small carryable barrel for denatured alcohol.
Helpful for carrying small amounts of denatured alcohol.
The tiny oak barrel, dark in color and, the spirit is trapped by a dense cork with a dark resinous texture.

name: IOV Lamp Top
descriptions: The top part of the IOV lamp. It for some reason is mesmersizing to look at.
It is made out of brass, the torch on the top is the most prominent feature.
A complex apparatus, however compact, it is a beautiful piece of machinery.

name: Set of matches
descriptions: A box of matches.
A small box of matches, with a striking surface on the side.

name: Fresnel lens clockwork apparatus
descriptions: A clockwork system composed of many gears, weights and pulleys.
You count many gears, until you begin to feel dizzy, so you stop counting.
Shinny brass and robust metal pulleys, the apparatus seems like the heart of some sort of beast.
When working, it manages to rotate the Fresnel lens with a steady rhythm.
Its weights drop all the way to the floor through a decending tube in the center of the lighthouse.

name: Fresnel lens
descriptions: A 1st order fresnel lens, large enought to hold a person inside of it.
A beehive of glass, refracts light in a very specific way, its groves create an entrancing glissening rainbow effect.
A giant and transparent jewel made out of glass, brought all the way from France.
With a tiny entrance around the bottom of the lens, it is possible to shimmy inside.
